Interface LevelResolver.LevelConfig

All Superinterfaces:
LevelResolver
Enclosing interface:
LevelResolver
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface LevelResolver.LevelConfig extends LevelResolver
A special resolver that has direct mappings of logger name to level via levelOrNull(String).

  • Method Details

    • levelOrNull

      @Nullable System.Logger.Level levelOrNull(String name)
      Returns a level exactly matching a logger name.
      Parameters:
      name - logger name.
      Returns:
      level or null.

    • defaultLevel

      default System.Logger.Level defaultLevel()
      The default level if no level is found. By default if not overridden this is calculated by calling levelOrNull(String) with an empty String and if it returns null ALL is returned.
      Returns:
      level

    • resolveLevel

      default System.Logger.Level resolveLevel(String name)
      Resolves a level by walking up the dotted path by calling levelOrNull(String) which follows Logbacks Effective Level. Determines what level the logger should be at. System.Logger.Level.ALL is to signal that nothing was resolved.
      Specified by:
      resolveLevel in interface LevelResolver
      Parameters:
      name - logger name.
      Returns:
      resolved level or System.Logger.Level.ALL if unable to resolve.

      Returns:
